newsitem.title: USA: Iridium says satellite liftoff successful.
newsitem.headline: Iridium says satellite liftoff successful.

text.p: Iridium LLC said the liftoff of five satellites on a Delta II rocket made by McDonnell Douglas Corp was a success and took place as expected at 0904 EDT/1304 GMT.
Satellite separation was expected approximately 1-1/2 hours after lift-off, according to a message on Iridium's launch advisory hotline.
The launch took place from Vandenberg Air Force Base in Lompoc, Calif.
If successful, the launch will bring the total number of orbiting Iridium satellites to 17.
The satellites would then be part of a 66-satellite network and would be placed into the third orbital plane of the satellite constellation, according to a previously released statement by Iridium.
